product.olivetti-echos-42.summary: The entry-level Echos paired a 486 with a monochrome display.
product.olivetti-echos-42.history: In June 1994, L’Unità reported the introduction of Echos as a notebook range positioned below Philos. The 42 was the lower-priced monochrome model. Computer Business Review reported a UK price of £1,270 and an October shipping start.
product.olivetti-echos-42.architecture: Expansion cards could add connectivity. The brochure documents a VESA local video bus and room for two Type II PCMCIA cards or one Type III card.
product.olivetti-echos-42.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-echos-42.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-echos-42.brochure: Olivetti, Echos Portable Personal Computers, 3994073P-00, 10/1994, pp. 2, 4.
product.olivetti-echos-42.market: Computer Business Review, 4 October 1994, Olivetti launches new range of terracotta notebook computers.
